title: C^{m+1} on an open set implies D^m is alpha-Hoelder on compact subsets
statement: Let E1, E2 be real normed spaces, m in N, 0 < alpha <= 1, V an open subset of E1 and h : E1 -> E2 with ContDiffOn R (m+1) h V. Then for every compact K contained in V there is C such that ||D^m h(x) - D^m h(y)|| <= C ||x - y||^alpha for all x, y in K, where D^m h = iteratedFDeriv R m h.
lean_statement: ∀ (E₁ E₂ : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E₁] [NormedSpace ℝ E₁] [NormedAddCommGroup E₂] [NormedSpace ℝ E₂] (m : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (h : E₁ → E₂) (V : Set E₁), 0 < α → α ≤ 1 → IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ (m + 1 : ℕ) h V → ∀ K : Set E₁, IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m h x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m h y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
